metadata.description: Example manifest using the ten gesture prompts from the original Avatar-Agent pipeline (gen_0 through gen_9). Replace paths with generated clips.

duration_policy.5_seconds_or_more: natural motion speed plus static tail

clips.caption: opens both palms upward slowly from the center of the abdomen to waist-chest height, holds, and returns, presenting a concept
opens both palms upward quickly and widely to chest-shoulder height, holds, and returns, symbolizing openness, possibility, or welcome
moves the right hand horizontally from the center toward the right with the palm turning forward, then makes two or three small waves to browse content or signal
spreads both palms upward from the abdomen toward both sides near shoulder height, holds briefly, and returns in a presenting gesture
opens both hands forward and upward, brings the palms together at the chest, holds, and returns, symbolizing fusion, combination, or completeness
opens both palms upward from the abdomen toward both sides at waist-chest height, holds, and returns in an explanatory open-hand gesture
opens both palms symmetrically to the sides and makes small upward-and-downward beats while holding the pose to emphasize the current point
raises the right hand from the abdomen to shoulder height with the palm forward and makes two or three small side-to-side waves for emphasis while the left hand stays still
keeps both hands naturally clasped in front of the abdomen while standing upright and attentively explaining, with no hand motion
raises the left hand from the abdomen to shoulder height with the palm forward and makes small side-to-side waves for emphasis while the right hand stays still
